The gated part of the dependency and CI debts chunk: the Epoch 2 boundary audit of escher-0.4.0 recorded and cleared by the operator's word; the codebase-health item moved planned to implemented.
It changed no source, no symbol, no crate, no dependency, no schema or config, no spec master; nothing retired; no new surface, operation or UI element.
Its readings are the corrective chunk's re-measures at the same head: stand test duplication under its earlier reading, the file and function size bars passing, the browser's four mutants caught, and every CI check green (17 of 17 jobs, the dependency audit among them).
At the wrap the founder ratified three forks on dependency-advisory waits (kept as waits on upstream releases), the hosted-runner hand re-run decision lost its provisional mark, and the memmap2 advisory wording was confirmed.
One edit after implement: the next version's deferral list takes four open dependency-advisory residuals.
